requirements.text: Patients must have the option to book appointments by phone
The system must provide clear instructions for online prescription requests
There should be a dedicated support line or chat feature for patient assistance
Implement automated onboarding messages or reminders for new patients
Scheduled follow-up calls or check-ins for patients who are new to the portal
Include a feedback mechanism within the portal for patients to share experiences
Provide multiple feedback options, such as surveys and direct communication channels
The system must ensure that patients feel supported throughout their usage
Support features must not overwhelm clinic staff
